verdict.rationale: Marketing copy claims a business account can be opened 'in minutes' and docs show APIs to programmatically create/onboard accounts, but there's no evidence detailing full end-to-end onboarding timeline (KYC/compliance verification, banking setup, migration from existing bank) that would substantiate a ~1 week full onboarding versus months elsewhere. missing for 10: independent/hands-on account of full onboarding timeline, evidence covering KYC/compliance approval speed, case studies of founders switching banks in ~1 week.
